annotations.title: Set how many answers each check captures

description: Change how many answers each check of up to 100 tracked queries captures (nPasses; above 1 only for AI engines). Fewer passes spend less budget; use get_usage to see the effect. Passes no longer captured are never made up later. Each one that cannot be changed is reported in "failed". Safe to retry.
name: set_tracked_query_passes
title: Set how many answers each check captures
